appleRequiredStatement: To submit your app, you must provide screenshots for the following required display sizes:
iPhone: At least one screenshot for iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display).
iPad (if your app supports iPadOS): At least one screenshot for iPad 13-inch display.

iphone-duo-outer.label: iPhone Duo (outer display)
iphone-duo-outer.appleRequirement: Starting in April 2027, screenshots will be required for any app using the iOS 27.1 SDK or later.

iphone-duo-inner.label: iPhone Duo (inner display)
iphone-duo-inner.appleRequirement: Starting in April 2027, screenshots will be required for any app using the iOS 27.1 SDK or later.

iphone-dynamic-island-large.label: iPhone with Dynamic Island (large display); commonly called 6.9-inch

iphone-face-id-large.label: iPhone with Face ID (large display); commonly called 6.5-inch
iphone-face-id-large.appleRequirement: Required if app runs on iPhone and screenshots for iPhone with Dynamic Island (large display) aren't provided

iphone-dynamic-island-medium.label: iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display); commonly called 6.3-inch
iphone-dynamic-island-medium.appleRequirement: Required device sizes: at least one screenshot for iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display)

ipad-13.label: iPad 13-inch display
ipad-13.appleRequirement: Required if app runs on iPad

coverageRules.condition: apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK or later (Labstream ships with Xcode 27.1 / iOS 27.1 SDK)

unknowns: Apple's page names iPhone classes (Dynamic Island large/medium, Face ID large) and gives no inch sizes; 6.9/6.5/6.3-inch labels are repository shorthand only.

The page states two iPhone requirements that it does not reconcile: Dynamic Island (medium) is listed as the required size, and Face ID (large) is required unless Dynamic Island (large) is provided. Coverage enforces both rules.
Apple gives only the month (April 2027) for the iPhone Duo requirement; coverage treats it as effective from 2027-04-01.
Apple does not say whether both iPhone Duo displays are required or whether one satisfies the requirement; coverage requires both.
Apple does not say whether iPhone Duo screenshots scale to or from other iPhone classes.
